summary: NovaBridge Biosciences, a Cayman Islands exempted company, filed a Form 6-K on July 24, 2026, announcing its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders (AGM) scheduled for September 8, 2026, in Shanghai, China. The filing includes a press release, notice of AGM, and proxy materials. Record date for ordinary shareholders is July 27, 2026 (Shanghai time); ADS holders must act through Citibank. No special-situation event is disclosed—this is a routine AGM notice for a foreign private issuer, analogous to a U.S. proxy statement filing. No price, stake, premium, or strategic transaction is mentioned. What to watch: this is a standard governance filing with no special-situations implications.
